title: Studio-alpha packaged acceptance
note: The ordered surfaces this harness proves against ONE serial, stateful, artifact-installed consumer. `live` surfaces are asserted on every run. A `reserved` surface names a proof that is deliberately not yet asserted and why; a reserved surface may never be silently dropped, and the harness prints the whole roster so a reader sees what was NOT proved alongside what was.

surfaces.summary: Every installed waaseyaa/* arrives as extracted archive bytes from the local artifact repository sealed from the exact candidate commit: no path repository, no VCS repository, no symlink into the checkout, no registry lookup for those names.
The governed installation phase completes and the shipped verification command reports the site contract healthy from installed bytes.
WAASEYAA_DEV_FALLBACK_ACCOUNT is absent from the generated environment and unset in the harness process, so no denial can be masked by a fallback identity.

A real administrator identity is seeded through the shipped installer, and a real unprivileged identity is seeded through the shipped user:create and actually signs in — the denial proof runs as that identity, so a denial is a policy decision rather than an absent session.

The artifact-installed backend and the artifact-installed admin bundle run as two separately controlled processes, each with its own reserved free port, pid, bounded readiness probe and retained log, under one idempotent root-owned teardown.

A real browser loads the admin bundle served from vendor/waaseyaa/admin-surface/dist by its own process, authenticates with the seeded identity, and performs an admin-visible operation against the artifact-installed backend with no route mocking, no fixture interception, and no source or API substitution; only the Playwright executable comes from the checkout's pinned toolchain.
A view-denied resource and a missing resource return the same typed ENTITY_NOT_FOUND 404: identical status, title, code, detail and full document bytes.
make:content-type publishes a seeded generation unit through the shared custody, recording ownership and its provider registration, and the extension is visible to the running application.
Destructive probes run only after a snapshot of the consumer's governed state, and the snapshot is restored and re-verified afterwards.

site:apply --interrupt-after-journal under an explicit development environment abandons publication after its journal is durable, and the next ordinary later-process apply recovers the interrupted transaction before completing.
An additive regeneration of the root site unit publishes through the same authority without disturbing the hand extension.
A plan that would evolve a frozen unit's artifact set is refused GEN011_UNAUTHORIZED_SET_DELTA and writes nothing.
After every probe the consumer verifies healthy again from installed bytes, proving the harness left the candidate in a governed state rather than a wreck it stopped measuring.
